Contact, Privacy, and Terms contain no pilot or concierge offer while General support remains available.
Search, social, structured data, robots, and sitemap describe only the free local-first application.
The pilot sample, inquiry template, promotion test, paid social image, and pilot sitemap entry do not ship.
At the supported 320 px viewport, setup flows directly to the footer with no paid offer or horizontal overflow.
Optional third-party provider charges are identified as provider-account costs, not an EDUTOOL tier or fee.
